results.title: Real Estate Parcel
results.description:
This feature layer contains Linn County, Iowa parcel geometry joined to County tax system information.  Parcel geometry is maintained by the Real Estate Division within the Auditor's Office.

 
 
Update Frequency
Approximately daily
 
 
Additional Resources
Visit Linn County, Iowa for County resources.
 
Visit Linn County, Iowa GIS for County GIS resources.
 
 
Contact Information
Questions?  Contact the GIS Division by phone at (319) 892-5250 or by email.

results.title: Treasurer Tax Distribution
results.description:
This feature layer displays Linn County, Treasurer's Office tax dollar distribution for real estate properties this tax year.  Datasets contained within this feature layer include:
  • TreasurerTaxDistributionParcel: Tax dollar distribution for real estate parcels this tax year
  • TreasurerTaxDistributionBLL: Tax dollar distribution for real estate buildings on leased land this tax year

Update Frequency
Approximately daily


Additional Resources
Visit Linn County, Iowa on the web.

Visit Linn County, Iowa GIS on the web.

Visit the Linn County, Iowa GIS portal.  This site is updated as needed to reflect maps, apps, and data of interest from various County departments.


Contact Information
Questions?  Contact the GIS Division by phone at 319.892.5250 or by email.

results.title: Treasurer Tax Percentile
results.description:
This feature layer displays Linn County, Treasurer's Office tax payable percent rank by property class and tax district for this tax year.  Datasets contained within this feature layer include:
  • TreasurerTaxPercentileParcel: Tax payable percentile ranking for real estate parcels by property class and tax district this tax year
  • TreasurerTaxPercentileBLL: Tax payable percentile ranking for real estate buildings on leased land by property class and tax district this tax year

Update Frequency
Approximately daily

results.title: Real Estate TIF District
results.description:
